---
title: Project Overview and Results Summary
---

This report is generated by **BioReport**, a component of CygnusX BioOps, from existing RNAFlow analysis outputs. It summarizes sequencing quality, contamination screening, alignment, sample relationships, differential expression and functional enrichment.

The report reads upstream results; it does not rerun alignment or statistical testing. Sample and group counts come from the sample sheet. Mean Q30 and mapping rate are arithmetic means across valid samples. Detected genes have TPM > 1 in at least one sample.

```{python}
#| label: pdf-project-summary
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from bioreport.config import load_config, display_path
from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import settings, ordered_samples
from bioreport.utils.render_output import show_print_table, typst_note
project_config = load_config()
input_files = project_config['input_files']
pdf_settings = settings(project_config)
project = project_config.get('project', {})
reference_genome = project.get('genome_version') or project.get('genome') or 'Reference Genome'
display(Markdown(f'This report is generated by **BioReport** in CygnusX BioOps from upstream RNAFlow outputs. It covers sequencing QC, contamination screening, reference ({reference_genome}) alignment, sample clustering, DEG classification and enrichment. These summaries support further review and reproducible data delivery.\n\n**Metric definitions**\n\n- **Samples and groups**: derived from the sample sheet.\n- **Mean Q30**: arithmetic mean of clean-read base fractions with Phred quality >= 30.\n- **Mean mapping rate**: mean clean-read alignment fraction against reference ({reference_genome}).\n- **Detected genes**: genes with TPM > 1 in at least one sample.'))
typst_note('Comparison summaries appear in Summary. Raw-P/log2FC display criteria are distinct from FDR control. Summary metrics do not automatically establish QC pass/fail or biological mechanisms.')
```

```{python}
#| label: pdf-sample-info
samples = pd.read_csv(input_files['sample_file'])
group_col = next((c for c in samples if c.lower() == 'group'), None)
if group_col:
    samples = samples.assign(**{group_col: samples[group_col].astype(str)}).sort_values(group_col, kind='stable')
limit = pdf_settings.get('sample_rows', 30)
show_print_table(samples.iloc[:, :6], limit=limit, caption='Samples and Experimental Groups', evidence={'kind': 'samples', 'sample_count': len(samples)}, note=f"Sample preview {min(limit, len(samples))} / {len(samples)} rows, up to 6 columns, ordered by group and within-group input order. Original sample-to-sample_name mapping is preserved. Full sample metadata (relative to data directory): {display_path(input_files['sample_file'], project_config)}")
```
